title: Concept to long-term use

captions.instagram:
A great concept is only the first stage of four. Then come construction, design and long-term use.

The question I'd ask at the end: will it still work in ten years?

Save the 4-stage execution check.

#RealEstate #Development #Execution

Where do projects slip most?
captions.facebook:
Plenty of projects look great on paper. I think the ones that last are designed for delivery: concept, construction, design and long-term use, each checked early.

#RealEstate #Development

Which stage do you think gets rushed?
captions.linkedin:
A concept is a promise. Execution is whether you keep it.

Every real estate project runs through four stages: concept (who is this for, and why them?), construction (can it be built on time and on budget?), design (does it support the people who'll use it?) and long-term use (will it still work in ten years?).

Gaps that aren't closed early show up later, when they cost more.

The check I'd run: Is the concept clear? Is the build feasible? Does the design serve users? Can it run for years?

#RealEstate #Execution
